title: Narrow English 1.6x counter card clips the end of Redirected
reproduction: Run scripts/run-ux-matrix.ps1 on API34 portrait 1080x2340 at 440 dpi (393 dp wide) in en-US 1.6x; inspect Home
expected: All three counter labels remain readable at the requested font scale without overlap or clipping
observed: redirectHostTextView needed 111 px with 71 px available; screenshot reads Redirecte
fix: Use 4 dp side insets instead of 16 dp on the three cards; leave vertical padding and font settings and the header status barrier unchanged

title: Wrapped source count loses its last line on narrow Home
reproduction: Open Home on API34 at 393 dp in he-IL 1.6x with three outdated sources
expected: Both count rows can grow and keep their actions and sync status clear
observed: The outdated count needed 170 px but had 88 px; its final word was missing
fix: Both labels wrap at a minimum height of 48 dp; start the next row or progress below the taller of the count and its action
